entries.note: al-Qāḍī in al-Mujarrad permits the first sister once the second has completed istibrāʾ (the reading: the bar falls on the amount by which the combination came about). Ibn Rajab prefers refraining from both, and al-Inṣāf makes that the madhhab, with al-Iqnāʿ, al-Muntahā and Kashshāf. Kashshāf gives the farq that the second has become firāsh. Against the reading.

evidence.excerpt_ar: لزمه أن يمسك عنهما حتى يحرم إحداهما. على الصحيح من المذهب. قدمه في
evidence.note: Having had the second sister against the rule, he must refrain from both until he makes one forbidden, «على الصحيح من المذهب».

evidence.excerpt_ar: حد فيه ولزمه أن يمسك عنهما حتى يحرم إحداهما
evidence.note: Stated decisively after intercourse with both, one after the other.

evidence.excerpt_ar: أو بيع بشرط خيار له فلو خالف ووطئ لزمه أن يمسك عنهما حتى يحرم إحداهما
evidence.note: Stated decisively: if he contravenes and has the second, he refrains from both.

evidence.excerpt_ar: حتى يحرم إحداهما ويشتريها) لأن الثانية صارت فراشا له يلحقه نسب ولدها
evidence.note: Refrain from both, because the second has become his firāsh, which forbids her sister as initial intercourse would.

entries.note: Two iḥtimālāt of al-Majd, neither marked by Ibn Rajab, and no later treatment found. Tawaqquf. Integrator: an iḥtimāl grades takhrīj, not a bare wajh; still a tie.

Two riwāyas on the diya when the one claimed against in qasāma declines the oaths. al-Inṣāf and Taṣḥīḥ al-Furūʿ make it owed. Against the reading, which does not establish one alternative by a proof that does not establish the cause.

evidence.excerpt_ar: والمستوعب، والخلاصة، والهادي، والفروع، والزركشي إحداهما: تلزمهم الدية.
evidence.note: On the defendants' declining the qasāma oaths: «إحداهما: تلزمهم الدية», followed by «وهو المذهب».

evidence.excerpt_ar: تلزمه الدية, وهو الصحيح, قال المصنف هنا: وهو أظهر, واختاره
evidence.note: The diya is owed by the one who declines, «وهو الصحيح».
